description: US-03 accuracy set: 50 fully synthetic voice-note transcripts with the tasks a careful human would extract. Names are invented first names; no real people, phone numbers or addresses. Dates resolve against each note's own 'today' and 'time_zone'. November 2026: Wed 4, Thu 5, Fri 6, Sat 7, Sun 8, Mon 9; Fri 20 / Mon 23 / Fri 27; Mon 30; Fri 4 Dec.
